sql: with mine as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders   where strategy='Emmsell10' and action='buy'   and status in ('filled','resting','open','pending','partially_filled')), latest as (select distinct on (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, p.quantity_fp, p.quantity,   p.market_exposure, p.realized_pnl, p.unrealized_pnl   from positions p join mine m on m.market_ticker=p.market_ticker   order by p.market_ticker, p.captured_at desc) select 'orders_by_status' as what, coalesce(status,'-') as k, count(*)::text as v   from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' group by status union all select 'orders_last_at','-', coalesce(max(created_at)::text,'-')   from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' union all select 'PNL_realized_total','sum_usd', coalesce(sum(realized_pnl),0)::text from latest union all select 'PNL_unrealized_total','sum_usd', coalesce(sum(unrealized_pnl),0)::text from latest union all select 'exposure_total','sum_usd', coalesce(sum(market_exposure),0)::text from latest union all select 'exposure_MAX_single','max_usd', coalesce(max(market_exposure),0)::text from latest union all select 'positions_open','count', count(*)::text from latest   where coalesce(abs(quantity_fp), abs(quantity), 0) > 0.01 union all select 'positions_settled_flat','count', count(*)::text from latest   where coalesce(abs(quantity_fp), abs(quantity), 0) <= 0.01 union all select 'worst_single_realized','min_usd', coalesce(min(realized_pnl),0)::text from latest
